fields.name: SQL Server Type Mapping
fields.responsibility: Covers the SQL Server type system property by property: for each SQL Server data type it declares how a model property becomes an input or output parameter of that type, how a parameter or result column of that type is read back into the property, and what the property's .NET type is allowed to be. It also offers the same per-type parameter construction directly to callers who build a parameter set by hand rather than from a model, and assembles a record identity's columns into typed parameters.
